The '''B3NK series''' was a droid series developed by [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]]. [[B3NK|One model]] accompanied [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] on his mission to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="star wars 4">[[Star Wars (1998) 4|''Star Wars'' (1998) 4]]</ref> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] a [[Nuna-Ball League]] team composed of B3NK series droids lost a game to [[Publictechnic]] [[JR series]] droids.<ref name="holonet">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|sports/1344_1.html|Nuna-Ball League Looks to Expand}}</ref>
